name: Kaskit
source: For as long as I can remember I have been trapped in this place called victory. I believe the knly way out is to tell the story I have taken woth me to the grave. The story I speak of is the truth, ofcourse.
translation: For as long as I can remember I have been trapped in this place called victory. I believe the knly way out is to tell the story I have taken woth me to the grave. The story I speak of is the truth, ofcourse.
